entities.name: Karador
entities.description: Karador Ghost Chieftain, a legendary centaur spirit and former high warchief, now king of wraiths and shades.

events.summary: Karador is slain in a great battle and deposed by a rival warchief.
events.quote: Karador was once a high warchief of his centaur tribe but was slain in a great battle.

events.summary: Karador, now a ghost, gathers ghostly minions for an assault on the rival warchief who deposed him.
events.quote: He gathers ghostly minions for an assault on the rival warchief who deposed him.
